blocks.text: Precipitate ko filter karne ka ek aur aasan tareeqa crucible ke zariye suction (hawa kheench kar) se hai. Aam taur par do type ke crucibles istemal hote hain.

1. Gooch crucible porcelain ka bana hota hai. Is ka bottom perforated (soorakhon wala) hota hai, jise paper pulp ya us ke size ka kata hua filter paper dhakta hai, Figure 15.3. Ise suction filtering apparatus mein rakh kar jaldi filtration ho jati hai. Yeh un precipitates ke liye useful (faidemand) hai jinhen bohat zyada temperature par garam (ignite) karna ho. Agar is ke soorakh asbestos mat se dhak diye jayen to is se woh solutions bhi filter ho sakte hain jo kaghaz se react karte hain, jaise concentrated HCl aur KMnO₄ ke solutions.

blocks.alt: Safed porcelain ka crucible ulta rakha hai taake us ka perforated bottom (soorakhon wala pendaa) nazar aaye; paas ek alag soorakhon wali disc aur ek gol plate.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.3: Gooch crucible (kitab ki Figure 15.3 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.alt: Glass ka crucible jis ke neeche ke hisse mein safed porous (bareek soorakhon wali) glass disc lagi hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.4: Sintered glass crucible (kitab ki Figure 15.4 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gooch crucible porcelain ka hai aur us ke bottom ke soorakhon par paper pulp ya filter paper rakhna parta hai. Sintered glass crucible mein porous (soorakhon wali) glass disc pehle se lagi hoti hai, is liye koi tayyari nahi chahiye. Dono suction (vacuum) ke saath istemal hote hain.

2. Sintered glass crucible glass ka crucible hai jis ke bottom mein porous glass disc sealed (pakki jari) hoti hai. Ise istemal karna bohat aasan hai kyun ke Gooch crucible ki tarah koi tayyari nahi karni parti, Figure 15.4.

blocks.prompt: a) Filtration mein istemal hone wale different filter media ke naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Saada filter paper (cone), fluted filter paper, Gooch crucible (paper pulp, filter paper ya asbestos mat ke saath) aur sintered glass crucible.

blocks.prompt: b) Filtration process ke components kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Mixture, filter medium (paper ya crucible) wala funnel ya crucible, aur neeche flask. Filtration ke baad do cheezen milti hain: filtrate (jo liquid guzar gaya) aur residue (jo solid filter par reh gaya).

blocks.prompt: c) Gravity filtration aur vacuum filtration mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Gravity filtration mein liquid apne wazan se filter paper ke cone se guzarta hai; yeh aahista hai. Vacuum filtration mein suction (pump) liquid ko crucible ya filter se kheenchta hai; yeh tez hai.

blocks.prompt: d) Gooch aur sintered glass crucible mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Gooch crucible porcelain ka hai; us ke soorakhon ko istemal se pehle paper pulp, filter paper ya asbestos mat se dhakna parta hai, aur ise tez garam kiya ja sakta hai. Sintered glass crucible glass ka hai jis mein porous glass disc pehle se lagi hai, is liye tayyari nahi chahiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke sawal (d) mein 'Different shade' chhapa hai; matlab 'Differentiate' (farq batayein) hai.

items: Filtration: ek component solvent mein hal karein, phir filter karein; jo hal nahi hota woh residue ban kar rukta hai, filtrate guzar jata hai (ret aur namak).
Filter media: 60-degree funnel mein paper cone (aahista), fluted paper (tez), Gooch crucible (suction, tez garmi; HCl aur KMnO₄ ke liye asbestos), sintered glass crucible (tayyari nahi).
